title: Jubilant Light French Coconut Macaron
description: A peppery and light French macaron featuring coconut cream and baking powder, perfect as a post-workout snack. This recipe is designed to be anti-inflammatory friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, sift together the almond flour, confectioners sugar, and baking powder.
In a large bowl, whip the egg whites and granulated sugar until stiff peaks form.
Add the black pepper and salt to the egg mixture and whip until combined.
Fold the dry ingredients into the egg mixture until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a piping bag and pipe small circles onto the prepared baking sheet.
Tap the baking sheet gently to remove any air bubbles and allow the macarons to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to form a skin.
Bake the macarons for 15 minutes, then allow them to cool completely on the baking sheet.
To assemble the macarons, pair up the shells by size and shape, then spoon a small amount of chilled coconut cream onto one half of each pair.
Top with the other half of the macaron and garnish with unsweetened shredded coconut.
